title: BJP President to lead march in Rohtak

tea.why: To counter the opposition's alleged misinformation, propaganda, and orchestrated chaos.
tea.want: To dismantle opposition narratives and bring facts directly to the people.
tea.changed: Oct 31: The BJP announced that party president Nitin Nabin will lead a march in Rohtak on November 1.

summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) announced that party national president Nitin Nabin will lead a 'Loktantra Bachao, Arajakta Hatao' padyatra in Rohtak, Haryana. According to a statement issued by the BJP, the march is scheduled for Sunday, November 1, 2026, starting from Chhotu Ram Polytechnic Ground and culminating at D-Park in Model Town, where Nabin will pay floral tributes to a statue of Mahatma Gandhi. The party stated that the campaign is designed to counter opposition misinformation and what it termed engineered chaos. Haryana BJP president Archana Gupta, senior leaders, thousands of party workers, and local residents are expected to participate in the event, which coincides with an opposition INDIA bloc rally in Delhi.
demands: Bring facts directly to the people
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: The BJP announced that national president Nitin Nabin will lead a padyatra in Rohtak on November 1, 2026.
